test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contain a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

The reason for my absence from the office was because I was ill.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'because I was ill'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'that I was ill'** should be used instead of** 'because I was ill'.**
 
• In the given sentence the use of '**because**' is **superfluous**. 
 
• It should be changed into '**that**'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The reason for my absence from the office was **that I was ill.***** **
